shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，手里举着一本空白的说明书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench holding up a thick blank booklet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课教你读懂化学品安全技术说明书。
overlay: 读懂化学品安全技术说明书

shots.scene: 试剂瓶和一本说明书并排，中间连着箭头
shots.prompt_en: A chemical bottle with a blank label and a thick blank booklet side by side, linked by a double arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 一瓶化学品，配一份说明书。

shots.scene: 阿杰拆开快递箱，拿出一瓶新试剂就要开盖
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens a delivery box, takes out a new reagent bottle and reaches for the cap right away.
shots.narration: 阿杰领到新试剂，拆开就想用。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指向箱子里的一叠空白纸
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and points at a stack of blank papers inside the box.
shots.narration: 小研问：说明书看了吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，看着那叠纸一脸茫然
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking puzzled at the thick stack of blank pages.
shots.narration: 阿杰发愁：十几页，从哪看起？

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起四根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises four fingers.
shots.narration: 别怕，记住四个问题就会读。

shots.section_title: 化学品离不开，也有危害
shots.scene: 试剂架上摆满各色试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A lab shelf full of colorful reagent bottles with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品，每天都在用。
overlay: 化学品离不开，也有危害

shots.section_title: 化学品离不开，也有危害
shots.scene: 小研戴手套在实验台前配制溶液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in lab coat, goggles and gloves prepares a solution at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 实验离不开它们。

shots.section_title: 化学品离不开，也有危害
shots.scene: 倒在地上的试剂瓶图标，旁边是黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tipped-over bottle on the floor next to a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 可防护不当，就会伤身体。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边浮现一圈 GHS 象形图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands among a ring of floating GHS hazard pictograms.
shots.narration: 危险化学品，种类可不少。

shots.scene: 火焰、腐蚀、感叹号三个 GHS 象形图
shots.prompt_en: Three GHS hazard pictograms in a row: a flame, corrosion and an exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃的、腐蚀的、刺激的；

shots.scene: 骷髅、健康危害两个 GHS 象形图
shots.prompt_en: Two GHS hazard pictograms: a skull and crossbones and a health hazard silhouette. No people.
shots.narration: 还有致敏、有毒，甚至致癌的。

shots.scene: 三条不同的小路分别通向防护、应急图标
shots.prompt_en: Three different paths, each leading to its own shield icon and its own first aid icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每一类，防护和应急都不一样。

shots.section_title: 安全用化学品的三个问题
shots.scene: 小研身旁浮现三个问号气泡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a bench with three blank question bubbles floating above her.
shots.narration: 安全用化学品，先问三个问题。
overlay: 安全用化学品的三个问题

shots.section_title: 安全用化学品的三个问题
shots.scene: 试剂柜、护目镜手套、急救箱三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a chemical storage cabinet, goggles with gloves, and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么拿怎么存，戴什么，出事怎么办。

shots.section_title: 过去靠物质安全数据单
shots.scene: 一本旧式厚文件夹，封面空白
shots.prompt_en: An old thick ring binder with a blank cover on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 过去，答案写在物质安全数据单里。
overlay: 过去靠物质安全数据单

shots.section_title: 过去靠物质安全数据单
shots.scene: 厂家仓库把一张空白单子随货装进箱里
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a factory sending a box with a blank data sheet tucked inside to a lab building. No people.
shots.narration: 生产商和进口商要随货提供。

shots.scene: 几张排版各不相同的空白单子散在桌上
shots.prompt_en: Several blank data sheets with completely different layouts scattered on a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 可那时的格式五花八门。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻着厚文件夹，满头大汗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips through a thick binder, sweating and searching.
shots.narration: 要找的信息，半天翻不到。

shots.scene: 沙漏和警示三角图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 紧急时，这会耽误宝贵时间。

shots.scene: 单子上密密麻麻的符号图标，阿杰皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a blank sheet surrounded by floating abstract technical symbols.
shots.narration: 旧单子术语多，像只写给专家看。

shots.scene: 消防员、急救员、实验人员三个小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Three person pictograms: one in a firefighter helmet, one with a medical cross, one in a lab coat. No people.
shots.narration: 可消防员、急救员和你，都要看懂。

shots.scene: 地球图标周围围着一圈握手图标
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon surrounded by a ring of handshake icons. No people.
shots.narration: 于是，联合国制定了全球统一制度。

shots.scene: 地球上不同位置的小人都看着同一个象形图
shots.prompt_en: Small person pictograms around a globe all looking at the same GHS hazard pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 让各国的人都能看懂化学品危害。

shots.scene: 一份整齐的空白说明书，十六个小格排列整齐
shots.prompt_en: A neat blank document with sixteen evenly arranged blank section boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 核心之一，就是统一的安全数据单。

shots.scene: 说明书旁出现对勾和对话气泡图标
shots.prompt_en: The neat document icon with a green check mark and a simple speech bubble icon. No people.
shots.narration: 格式固定，语言具体好懂。

shots.scene: 地球图标上多个国家亮起
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon with many regions lighting up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 多数国家都在采用这套制度。

shots.scene: 王老师站在空白展板前讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands in front of a blank display board and explains to students.
shots.narration: 我国也有自己的要求。

shots.scene: 一瓶试剂旁边配一份说明书、瓶身一张标签
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a blank label on it, next to a blank booklet, both highlighted with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 危险化学品，要一书一签。

shots.scene: 两本空白标准文本并排
shots.prompt_en: Two blank standard booklets side by side on a desk with a GHS hazard pictogram on the covers. No people.
shots.narration: 分类和标签，按GB30000系列。

shots.scene: 一份空白说明书，十六个分栏编号亮起
shots.prompt_en: A blank document with sixteen numbered section tabs lighting up in order. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书十六部分，按GB/T16483。

shots.scene: 王老师递给阿杰一份中文说明书
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands the young male student a blank booklet.
shots.narration: 中文名叫化学品安全技术说明书。

shots.section_title: 与旧格式相近，2、3 部分互换
shots.scene: 两份空白说明书并排，第二、三栏用箭头互换
shots.prompt_en: Two blank documents side by side; arrows show the second and third sections swapping places. No people.
shots.narration: 新格式和旧版很像，
overlay: 与旧格式相近，2、3 部分互换

shots.section_title: 与旧格式相近，2、3 部分互换
shots.scene: 老周看着说明书点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man looks at a blank booklet and nods with a smile.
shots.narration: 只是第二、三部分换了位置。

shots.scene: 一份说明书分成上中下三层，最上层发亮
shots.prompt_en: A blank document divided into three layers; the top layer glows brightly. No people.
shots.narration: 内容按需要的先后排列。

shots.scene: 最上层浮现身份牌、警示三角、急救箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an ID badge, a warning triangle and a first aid kit rise from the top layer. No people.
shots.narration: 最前面：是什么、有何危害、怎么急救。

shots.scene: 中间层浮现盾牌图标，下层浮现图表图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon rises from the middle layer and a chart icon from the bottom layer. No people.
shots.narration: 接着是易懂的防护，技术数据放后面。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起四张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up four blank cards in a fan.
shots.narration: 说明书，回答四个问题。

shots.scene: 四张卡片分别连向说明书的不同分栏
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards each connected by lines to different groups of sections in a blank document. No people.
shots.narration: 每个问题，对应几个部分。

shots.section_title: 第1部分：化学品及企业标识
shots.scene: 说明书第一栏发亮，旁边是试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The first section of a blank document glows, next to a reagent bottle with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 第一部分，说明它是什么。
overlay: 第1部分：化学品及企业标识

shots.section_title: 第1部分：化学品及企业标识
shots.scene: 说明书上的名称框和瓶签名称框用线连起来
shots.prompt_en: A name box on the blank document and a name box on the bottle label are linked by a line with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这里的名称，和瓶上标签一致。

shots.section_title: 第1部分：化学品及企业标识
shots.scene: 工厂、地址、电话三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a factory building, a map pin and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 还有供应商名称、地址和电话。

shots.section_title: 第1部分：化学品及企业标识
shots.scene: 红色电话图标闪烁
shots.prompt_en: A red telephone icon with a small alarm burst beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 可能还有应急咨询电话。

shots.scene: 说明书第二栏发亮，出现 GHS 象形图
shots.prompt_en: The second section of a blank document glows, with GHS hazard pictograms beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二部分，概述它的危险性。

shots.scene: 信号词框、危险说明框、防范说明框三个空白框
shots.prompt_en: Three blank boxes stacked, each with a small icon: an exclamation, a warning triangle and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 信号词、危险说明、防范说明。

shots.scene: 红边菱形象形图从说明书移到瓶签上
shots.prompt_en: A GHS hazard pictogram moves from the blank document onto a bottle label. No people.
shots.narration: 和标签上的象形图是一样的。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个大号的试剂瓶标签
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a large reagent bottle with a big label showing GHS hazard pictograms and blank text lines.
shots.narration: 标签，是说明书的浓缩版。

shots.scene: 标签上依次亮起名称、象形图、信号词区域
shots.prompt_en: Areas of a large bottle label light up one by one: a name line, GHS hazard pictograms, a bold word box. No people.
shots.narration: 看名称、看象形图、看信号词。

shots.scene: 两个信号词框，一个深红一个橙色
shots.prompt_en: Two blank word boxes side by side, one dark red marked with two exclamation marks, one orange with one. No people.
shots.narration: 危险比警告更严重。

shots.scene: 标签下部亮起说明文字区、电话图标、书本图标
shots.prompt_en: The lower part of the label lights up: blank text lines, a telephone icon and a small book icon. No people.
shots.narration: 再看说明、供应商和应急电话。

shots.scene: 标签要素按 GB 15258 排列
shots.prompt_en: A neat label layout with all elements in place and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 标签怎么写，按GB15258。

shots.section_title: 分装瓶、自配试剂也要贴标签
shots.scene: 小研把试剂倒进小瓶，准备贴标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves has decanted a reagent into a small bottle and holds a blank label.
shots.narration: 分装出来的小瓶，也要贴标签。
overlay: 分装瓶、自配试剂也要贴标签

shots.section_title: 分装瓶、自配试剂也要贴标签
shots.scene: 小瓶标签上几个空白栏依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A small bottle label with blank fields being checked off one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 写名称、浓度、日期和配制人。

shots.section_title: 分装瓶、自配试剂也要贴标签
shots.scene: 没贴标签的瓶子和字迹模糊的瓶子被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an unlabeled bottle and a bottle with a smeared faded label, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 无标签、标签糊了，都不能用。

shots.section_title: 分装瓶、自配试剂也要贴标签
shots.scene: 阿杰把标签破损的瓶子交给小研
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a bottle with a damaged label to the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 标签坏了，及时补贴或上报。

shots.scene: 说明书第三栏发亮，出现分子结构图标
shots.prompt_en: The third section of a blank document glows, with a simple molecule icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第三部分，写成分和组成。

shots.scene: 几个空白编号框排成一列
shots.prompt_en: A column of blank ID boxes with small icons: a molecule, a tag and a barcode. No people.
shots.narration: 化学名、俗名，还有登记编号。

shots.section_title: 第4–6部分：出了问题怎么办
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第二张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the second blank card from the fan of four.
shots.narration: 第二个问题：出了问题怎么办？
overlay: 第4–6部分：出了问题怎么办

shots.section_title: 第4–6部分：出了问题怎么办
shots.scene: 急救箱、灭火器、泄漏桶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a first aid kit, a fire extinguisher and a spill kit bucket. No people.
shots.narration: 看第四、五、六部分。

shots.scene: 说明书第四栏发亮，旁边是急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The fourth section of a blank document glows, next to a first aid kit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四部分，是急救措施。

shots.scene: 皮肤、眼睛、鼻子、嘴四个接触途径图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a hand, an eye, a nose and a mouth. No people.
shots.narration: 按接触途径，分别写怎么处理。

shots.scene: 阿杰在水槽边脱下沾湿的实验服，冲洗手臂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes off a splashed lab coat and rinses his forearm under running water at a sink.
shots.narration: 沾到皮肤：脱掉污染衣物，冲洗。

shots.scene: 肥皂和流水图标，旁边医院图标
shots.prompt_en: A soap bar icon and running water icon next to a hospital icon. No people.
shots.narration: 用肥皂和水洗净，再去就医。

shots.scene: 小研在洗眼器前冲洗眼睛
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student flushes her eyes at an eyewash station with water flowing.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛：马上用大量清水冲洗。

shots.scene: 医院图标和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A hospital building icon with a red cross. No people.
shots.narration: 冲洗后，立即就医。

shots.scene: 一个小人图标周围浮现咳嗽、头晕、红肿图标
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram surrounded by small icons of coughing, dizziness swirls and a red rash. No people.
shots.narration: 这里还写了可能出现的症状。

shots.scene: 小研扶着头晕的阿杰坐下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the dizzy young male student sit down on a chair.
shots.narration: 帮你判断，有没有人受到暴露。

shots.section_title: 用前先读急救，认清应急设施
shots.scene: 欣欣翻开说明书，指着第四栏
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank booklet and points at the fourth section tab.
shots.narration: 用之前，就要先读第四部分。
overlay: 用前先读急救，认清应急设施

shots.section_title: 用前先读急救，认清应急设施
shots.scene: 急救点标志、洗眼台标志、安全淋浴标志并排
shots.prompt_en: A first aid sign, an eyewash sign and a safety shower sign side by side on a lab wall. No people.
shots.narration: 还要知道急救箱、洗眼器在哪。

shots.section_title: 用前先读急救，认清应急设施
shots.scene: 小研带阿杰走到紧急喷淋下，抬手指向拉杆
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks the young male student to an emergency safety shower and points at the pull handle.
shots.narration: 紧急喷淋在哪，也要心里有数。

shots.section_title: 第5部分：燃烧危害与灭火剂
shots.scene: 说明书第五栏发亮，旁边是火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The fifth section of a blank document glows, next to a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第五部分，讲消防措施。
overlay: 第5部分：燃烧危害与灭火剂

shots.section_title: 第5部分：燃烧危害与灭火剂
shots.scene: 燃烧的烧杯冒出黑烟，黑烟里有骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a burning beaker giving off dark smoke with a skull symbol in the smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 有的物质烧起来，会放出有毒烟气。

shots.section_title: 第5部分：燃烧危害与灭火剂
shots.scene: 水、泡沫、二氧化碳、干粉四个灭火剂图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons of extinguishing agents: water drops, foam, a gas cloud and powder. No people.
shots.narration: 这里写明该用哪种灭火剂。

shots.section_title: 第5部分：燃烧危害与灭火剂
shots.scene: 水浇向一个燃烧的油盘图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water being poured onto a burning pan of liquid, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用错灭火剂，会火上浇油。

shots.section_title: 第5部分：灭火策略与消防防护
shots.scene: 灭火策略示意：箭头从上风方向指向火焰
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram with arrows approaching a flame icon from one side, with a wind arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 还写了灭火的基本策略。
overlay: 第5部分：灭火策略与消防防护

shots.section_title: 第5部分：灭火策略与消防防护
shots.scene: 消防服和空气呼吸器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a firefighter suit, a helmet and a breathing apparatus with an air tank. No people.
shots.narration: 以及消防人员需要的防护装备。

shots.section_title: 第5部分：灭火策略与消防防护
shots.scene: 老周把说明书交给赶到的保卫处值班员
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a blank booklet to the arriving security officer at the lab door.
shots.narration: 火警来了，把说明书交给救援人员。

shots.scene: 说明书第六栏发亮，旁边是泄漏液滴图标
shots.prompt_en: The sixth section of a blank document glows, next to a spill puddle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第六部分，是泄漏应急处理。

shots.scene: 围堵、清理、去污三个图标依次出现
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in sequence: absorbent booms surrounding a puddle, a dustpan with absorbent, and a spray bottle with a cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么围堵、怎么清理、怎么去污。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套和护目镜，从溢洒处理箱取出吸附材料
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves takes absorbent pads out of a spill kit.
shots.narration: 照着做，再用溢洒处理箱。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起第三张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the third blank card from the fan of four.
shots.narration: 第三个问题：怎样预防？

shots.scene: 储存柜、防护镜、温度计、反应烧瓶四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a storage cabinet, goggles, a thermometer and a reaction flask. No people.
shots.narration: 答案在第七到第十部分。

shots.section_title: 第7部分：操作处置与储存
shots.scene: 说明书第七栏发亮，旁边是试剂柜
shots.prompt_en: The seventh section of a blank document glows, next to a chemical storage cabinet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第七部分，讲操作和储存。
overlay: 第7部分：操作处置与储存

shots.section_title: 第7部分：操作处置与储存
shots.scene: 眼睛、皮肤、衣物图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eye, a hand and a shirt protected by a shield from a splash. No people.
shots.narration: 比如避免接触眼睛、皮肤和衣物。

shots.section_title: 第7部分：操作处置与储存
shots.scene: 阿杰双手捧着拧紧盖子的瓶子，放进提篮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks that a bottle cap is tight and places the bottle in a carrying basket.
shots.narration: 搬运前，确认容器盖好拿稳。

shots.section_title: 第7部分：操作处置与储存
shots.scene: 温度计、湿度、通风、振动、阳光五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a thermometer, a water drop, a fan, vibration waves and a sun. No people.
shots.narration: 储存条件也写在这里。

shots.scene: 说明书第八栏发亮，旁边是通风柜
shots.prompt_en: The eighth section of a blank document glows, next to a fume hood icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第八部分，讲接触控制。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜内操作，气流箭头向上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a fume hood with the sash lowered; airflow arrows go up into the hood.
shots.narration: 工程控制，比如局部排风。

shots.scene: 手套箱图标，四周封闭
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sealed glove box with gloves attached and a closed lock symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 有的物质，要在密闭系统里操作。

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、实验服、防毒面具四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: safety goggles, gloves, a lab coat and a half-face respirator. No people.
shots.narration: 这里也写了该戴什么防护。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着防毒面具给阿杰讲解滤毒罐
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shows a half-face respirator with cartridges to the young male student.
shots.narration: 呼吸防护，要选对滤毒罐。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles.
shots.narration: 眼睛戴安全眼镜或护目镜。

shots.scene: 小研从盒子里取出手套戴上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes gloves from a box and puts them on.
shots.narration: 皮肤靠手套和防护服。

shots.scene: 仪表盘上有一条限值线
shots.prompt_en: A gauge icon with a red limit line and a needle well below it. No people.
shots.narration: 还列出职业接触限值。

shots.scene: 老周看着限值图标，规划通风柜和防护用品
shots.prompt_en: The older man studies a gauge icon and points at a fume hood and a box of gloves.
shots.narration: 单位据此安排通风和防护。

shots.scene: 说明书第九栏发亮，旁边是温度计和水滴
shots.prompt_en: The ninth section of a blank document glows, next to thermometer and water drop icons. No people.
shots.narration: 第九部分，是理化特性。

shots.scene: 固体、液体、气体三个状态图标和温度计
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a solid cube, a liquid drop and a gas cloud next to a thermometer and a pH strip. No people.
shots.narration: 状态、熔点、沸点、酸碱性等。

shots.scene: 小研对照说明书，选择合适的操作方式
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares a blank booklet with her experiment notes at a bench.
shots.narration: 帮你判断用途和该怎么防护。

shots.scene: 标签破损的瓶子旁边，说明书和放大镜
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a torn label next to a blank booklet and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 标签坏了，它也能帮助辨认。

shots.section_title: 第10部分：稳定性和反应性
shots.scene: 说明书第十栏发亮，旁边是天平图标
shots.prompt_en: The tenth section of a blank document glows, next to a balanced scale icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十部分，讲稳定性和反应性。
overlay: 第10部分：稳定性和反应性

shots.section_title: 第10部分：稳定性和反应性
shots.scene: 热、压力、冲击三个图标都打上警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a flame, a pressure gauge and an impact burst, each with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 写明要避免受热、受压和撞击。

shots.section_title: 第10部分：稳定性和反应性
shots.scene: 两只瓶子靠在一起冒烟，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two incompatible bottle icons placed together giving off smoke, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也写明不能和哪些物质放一起。

shots.section_title: 第10部分：稳定性和反应性
shots.scene: 试剂柜里不同瓶子被隔板分开
shots.prompt_en: A storage cabinet with bottles separated into different compartments by dividers. No people.
shots.narration: 禁配的化学品，要分开存放。

shots.section_title: 第10部分：稳定性和反应性
shots.scene: 烧瓶冒泡图标旁出现分解、聚合箭头
shots.prompt_en: A flask icon with bubbles and arrows showing breakdown into smaller pieces and linking into chains. No people.
shots.narration: 分解、聚合等危险，也写在这里。

shots.section_title: 第11–16部分：还需要知道什么
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第四张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up the fourth blank card from the fan of four.
shots.narration: 第四个问题：还要知道什么？
overlay: 第11–16部分：还需要知道什么

shots.section_title: 第11–16部分：还需要知道什么
shots.scene: 王老师和老周对着说明书编写操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man write a blank procedure document while referring to a blank booklet.
shots.narration: 后几部分，常用于编写操作规程。

shots.section_title: 第11–16部分：还需要知道什么
shots.scene: 阿杰快速翻阅说明书后半部分
shots.prompt_en: The young male student quickly flips through the back half of a blank booklet.
shots.narration: 你也应该快速浏览一遍。

shots.scene: 说明书第十一栏发亮，旁边是人体轮廓图标
shots.prompt_en: The eleventh section of a blank document glows, next to a human body outline icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十一部分，是毒理学信息。

shots.scene: 人体图标上标出途径，旁边有闪电和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with marked entry points, beside a lightning icon and a clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 接触途径、症状、急性和迟发影响。

shots.scene: 说明书第十二栏发亮，旁边是树和鱼图标
shots.prompt_en: The twelfth section of a blank document glows, next to a tree and fish icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十二部分，讲对环境的影响。

shots.scene: 说明书第十三栏发亮，旁边是废液桶
shots.prompt_en: The thirteenth section of a blank document glows, next to a closed waste container icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十三部分，讲废弃怎么处置。

shots.scene: 水槽下水道图标被红叉划掉，废液桶打勾
shots.prompt_en: A sink drain icon crossed out with a red X next to a closed waste container with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 危险废物，不能倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 说明书第十四栏发亮，旁边是货车图标
shots.prompt_en: The fourteenth section of a blank document glows, next to a delivery truck icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十四部分，是运输信息。

shots.scene: 货包上贴着危险货物菱形标签
shots.prompt_en: A shipping box with dangerous goods labels on its side and a blank number plate. No people.
shots.narration: 联合国编号、运输类别、包装类别。

shots.scene: 说明书第十五栏发亮，旁边是法槌图标
shots.prompt_en: The fifteenth section of a blank document glows, next to a gavel icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十五部分，列出相关法规。

shots.scene: 说明书第十六栏发亮，旁边是日历和铅笔图标
shots.prompt_en: The sixteenth section of a blank document glows, next to a calendar icon and a pencil icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第十六部分，是其他信息。

shots.scene: 日历图标上有一个修订箭头
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with a circular update arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 包括编制和修订的日期。

shots.section_title: SDS 的索取、存放与更新
shots.scene: 小研从供应商箱子里取出说明书，放进文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a blank booklet out of a supplier box and files it in a binder.
shots.narration: 买试剂，要索取中文说明书。
overlay: SDS 的索取、存放与更新

shots.section_title: SDS 的索取、存放与更新
shots.scene: 实验室门口的文件架和电脑屏幕都有说明书图标
shots.prompt_en: A binder rack by the lab door and a computer screen both showing a blank document icon. No people.
shots.narration: 纸质或电子版，放在随手可查处。

shots.section_title: SDS 的索取、存放与更新
shots.scene: 化学品台账和说明书一一对应
shots.prompt_en: A blank inventory list with lines linking each row to a blank booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 台账上的每种化学品，都要有一份。

shots.section_title: SDS 的索取、存放与更新
shots.scene: 旧说明书被换成新版，日历图标翻页
shots.prompt_en: An old blank booklet is swapped for a new one, next to a calendar icon turning a page. No people.
shots.narration: 有了新版本，及时更换。

shots.section_title: 用前读 SDS，做风险评估
shots.scene: 阿杰坐下认真读说明书，小研在旁
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits and reads a blank booklet carefully; the female graduate student sits beside him.
shots.narration: 新实验开始前，先读说明书。
overlay: 用前读 SDS，做风险评估

shots.section_title: 用前读 SDS，做风险评估
shots.scene: 危害、操作、防护、应急四个格子逐个打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank four-box checklist with icons of a warning triangle, a flask, goggles and a first aid kit, each getting a check. No people.
shots.narration: 找出危害，定好防护和应急办法。

shots.section_title: 用前读 SDS，做风险评估
shots.scene: 老周在评估单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank risk assessment form held by the young male student.
shots.narration: 评估好了，请导师把关再动手。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁边写着119和120
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with two blank number cards beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 起火拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：实验室—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a lab room, a department building and a security office. No people.
shots.narration: 同时报告实验室负责人和学院。

shots.scene: 小研把说明书交给赶来的保卫处值班员
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a blank booklet to the security officer at the lab door; a small red cross icon floats beside it.
shots.narration: 送医时，带上说明书或标签。

shots.section_title: 知道 SDS 在哪，用前先读
shots.scene: 欣欣站在说明书文件架旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a binder rack holding blank booklets.
shots.narration: 说明书，是用好化学品的工具。
overlay: 知道 SDS 在哪，用前先读

shots.section_title: 知道 SDS 在哪，用前先读
shots.scene: 标签与说明书用线连起，部分内容重合
shots.prompt_en: A bottle label and a blank booklet linked by lines where matching parts overlap. No people.
shots.narration: 标签上的内容，在说明书里更详细。

shots.section_title: 知道 SDS 在哪，用前先读
shots.scene: 阿杰走到文件架前，取下一份说明书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks to the binder rack and takes out a blank booklet.
shots.narration: 记住：说明书放在哪里。

shots.section_title: 知道 SDS 在哪，用前先读
shots.scene: 阿杰读完说明书，戴好护目镜手套开始实验
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, now in goggles and gloves, closes the booklet and starts work at the bench.
shots.narration: 每用一种化学品，先读再用。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四张问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four floating blank cards.
shots.narration: 十六部分，回答四个问题。

shots.scene: 1–3 与 4–6 两组分栏发亮
shots.prompt_en: Two groups of section tabs glow: the first three and the next three. No people.
shots.narration: 前三部分讲危害，四到六讲应急。

shots.scene: 7–10 与 11–16 两组分栏发亮
shots.prompt_en: Two more groups of section tabs glow: four tabs and six tabs. No people.
shots.narration: 七到十讲预防，后面是补充信息。

shots.scene: 瓶签和说明书并排打勾
shots.prompt_en: A bottle with a label and a blank booklet side by side with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 一书一签，分装瓶也要贴标签。

shots.scene: 说明书文件架和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A binder rack icon next to a telephone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 知道放在哪，出事带上它。

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着说明书向镜头挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hugs a blank booklet and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 先读说明书，再碰化学品，下次见！
